name: wallet_takeout
text: Stand relaxed with both arms down. Reach the RIGHT hand to the right hip pocket, take out a wallet and bring it only to waist height in front of the abdomen. Use the LEFT hand briefly to open and check the wallet while looking down. Close it, move it back to the right hip pocket with the RIGHT hand, tuck it away, release it and lower both empty arms beside the thighs. Finish standing relaxed. Keep elbows low; never raise the wallet near the face.
